PaymentService/Authorize.no3ds_fail_payment: Native Authorize only creates the browser form; card declines happen after the gateway/browser interaction and cannot be asserted as a synchronous Authorize error.

PaymentService/Get.sync_payment: The harness must first complete the native gateway form in a browser to obtain a payment eligible for Query.
PaymentService/Get.sync_payment_with_handle_response: The harness must first complete the native gateway form in a browser to obtain a payment eligible for Query.

PaymentService/Capture.capture_full_amount: Requires a manually authorized AsiaPay payment and its real PayRef; native Authorize alone is AuthenticationPending.
PaymentService/Capture.capture_partial_amount: Requires a manually authorized AsiaPay payment and its real PayRef; native Authorize alone is AuthenticationPending.
PaymentService/Capture.capture_with_merchant_order_id: Requires a manually authorized AsiaPay payment and its real PayRef; native Authorize alone is AuthenticationPending.

PaymentService/Void.void_authorized_payment: Requires browser completion of a manual-capture payment and its real PayRef.
PaymentService/Void.void_without_cancellation_reason: Requires browser completion of a manual-capture payment and its real PayRef.
PaymentService/Void.void_with_amount: Requires browser completion of a manual-capture payment and its real PayRef.

PaymentService/Refund.refund_full_amount: Requires browser completion and a real captured PayRef; the harness cannot drive the native gateway form.
PaymentService/Refund.refund_partial_amount: Requires browser completion and a real captured PayRef; the harness cannot drive the native gateway form.
PaymentService/Refund.refund_with_reason: Requires browser completion and a real captured PayRef; the harness cannot drive the native gateway form.

PaymentService/VerifyRedirectResponse.verify_redirect_fail_tampered: AsiaPay return parameters are unsigned and deliberately source_verified=false; a gateway signature-validation error is not applicable. PSync or a verified Data Feed remains authoritative.

RefundService/Get.refund_sync: Requires a manually completed captured payment and refund, including real gateway identifiers.
RefundService/Get.RefundService/Get: Requires a manually completed captured payment and refund, including real gateway identifiers.
RefundService/Get.refund_sync_with_reason: Requires a manually completed captured payment and refund, including real gateway identifiers.
